name: GearBeacon
releaseNotes: GearBeacon 1.0.0 is the first stable release of the private, self-hosted UniFi Store monitor for Windows, macOS, Linux, servers, NAS hosts, and Docker. It includes regional watchlists, confirmed stock and price history, durable notifications, owner authentication, encrypted integration secrets, validated backup and recovery workflows, responsive accessibility, diagnostics, and reproducible release artifacts.
